title: Simulation prebrief
description: The briefing read to learners before a simulation or case study: objectives, a summary of the scenario, ground rules (confidentiality, psychological safety, the right to step out), orientation to the tools and roles, and the notices about scoring and who sees answers. Follows the structure of recognized simulation standards without reproducing their text.

examples: Sepsis after surgery: an unfolding case study
Recognize the cues that show a patient is changing

scenarioSummary.description: What the scenario is, in a few sentences
examples: A simulated patient, day 2 after surgery. The case unfolds in six stages with questions at each.
